name: trotebox-platform
description: Plataforma original de trotes de comédia com frontend responsivo, créditos, telefonia programável e clientes web/mobile.

scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @trotebox/contracts && npm run lint -w @trotebox/db && npm run lint -w @trotebox/api && npm run lint -w @trotebox/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @trotebox/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @trotebox/db && npm run typecheck -w @trotebox/api && npm run typecheck -w @trotebox/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @trotebox/contracts && npm run test -w @trotebox/db && npm run test -w @trotebox/api && npm run test -w @trotebox/web
scripts.quality: npm run validate:repo && npm run test:domain && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build:web
scripts.build:all: npm run build -w @trotebox/contracts && npm run build -w @trotebox/db && npm run build -w @trotebox/api && npm run build -w @trotebox/web
scripts.quality:full: npm run validate:repo && npm run test:domain && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build:all
